observation.command:
cd /workspace/profile/modules/custom
for m in openculturas_custom openculturas_media openculturas_teaser openculturas_address_links dark_mode_toggle openculturas_slimselect openculturas_slimselect_bef; do
  if [ -f "$m/$m.info.yml" ]; then
    echo "=== $m deps ==="
    awk '/^dependencies:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' "$m/$m.info.yml"
  fi
done
echo ""
echo "=== openculturas_slimselect dir contents ==="
ls openculturas_slimselect/
